svg.text: Main build 2026.11.01 – 11.16 · Fri–Sun, afternoon–1 AM, 5–6 h/day · solo design & build
Local LLM research (FP12) · job monitoring · remote access — 2 PCs + Raspberry Pi + 2 devices at home
Status is observed by the system, not reported by agents.
· Job progress/failure: jobwatch reads the logs
· Overheat: the clock reads main PC temps itself
· Making agents report adds work and slows them down
· Mostly built in Rust, self-hosted, no paid services
